notes.title: Flowchart Fixed, Fan Pack DLC, Achievement
notes.notes:
We've just found out that the Flowchart is not working as intended. The game has been updated to fix this.

Our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1210630/DIVINATION__Fan_Pack_Art_Book_Wallpaper_Soundtrack/]Fan Pack DLC[/url] is now available on Steam. Included in this DLC is 1 Mini Artbook, 4 Tarot Wallpapers, and 5 Ominous Ethno-Futuristic Soundtracks. 
The Mini Artbook contains early sketches, unused content from the game, and spoiler of the ending.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36261704/fd505ac7c68255063bb3136e7dc8d586688e8d79.png[/img]

Also, we've added an achievement for the game.
